newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's railway approves 7.29 trln lire investment.
newsitem.headline: Italy's railway approves 7.29 trln lire investment.

text.p: ROME, July 3 - The board of Italy's state-owned rail company Ferrovie dello Stato (FS) has approved investments for 7.29 trillion lire, the company said in a statement on Thursday.
Of the total, some 1.65 trillion will go towards further development of Italy's high-speed train system.
Another 2.99 trillion will be invested to develop the rail system in Italy's south, it added.
The investments come out of funds transferred to the rail company in the government's 1996 budget, the statement said.
